title: Widget proposal: numericRefinementList

comments.body:
Go @maxiloc ! :+1: 

Only question I have is: do we do to use `numericAttributeName` or could we just go for `attributeName` (we already make it clear it's about numeric refinements)?
I assume we can easily reuse the `RefinementList` component, and just create a new widget, right?

> could we just go for attributeName

Yes it's better

> I assume we can easily reuse the RefinementList component, and just create a new widget, right?

Yes I guess so

> I assume we can easily reuse the RefinementList component, and just create a new widget, right?

Yes also, as long as it's not modifying too much the refinement list component, should not since it's just about sending the right facetValues to it and the right refine function :)
